summary: Implemented imapclient/tls.py (IMAP4_TLS with timeout-aware _create_socket wrapping the socket in TLS, typed send/socket overrides, and the module-level wrap_socket helper used by starttls) and imapclient/interact.py (main() with argparse options merged over config defaults and the INI file, credential prompting, connection error handling, and an IPython or code.interact shell with the client bound to c); exceptions.py needed no changes. The last full-suite run gave 81 passed and 5 failed, plus 13 collection errors, all from another builder's imapclient.py require_capability stub, so the tests exercising my files (test_init, test_starttls) could not be collected yet; I verified tls.py with a real TLS handshake over a socketpair and interact.main with stubbed siblings.
